title: Toward the Goldilocks Blind Compression of Quantum States
summary: Quantum autoencoders (QAEs) are learning architectures that compress quantum data into a low-dimensional latent state while preserving the information needed for reconstruction. We study blind single-copy compression of quantum states through a $k$-qubit bottleneck and investigate the minimal circuit width required to attain the information-theoretic optimum under average infidelity.
